figures.name: Amma

ability.name: Cosmic Egg
ability.description: Reset the entire field: all cards return to their base stats.

figures.description: Supreme creator who spun the cosmic egg of creation and whose love for the earth created all life.

figures.name: Nommo

ability.name: Twin Waters
ability.description: Duplicate one ally: create an identical copy with same stats for 2 turns.

figures.description: Primordial twin water beings born from Amma who descended to earth and civilized humanity.

figures.name: Ogo/Pale Fox

ability.name: Imperfect Design
ability.description: Reduce the highest stat of all enemies by 2 permanently from cosmic disorder.

figures.description: Rebellious first creation of Amma who introduced disorder into the universe by acting before completion.

figures.name: Lebe

ability.name: Soil Rebirth
ability.description: At end of battle, resurrect the oldest fallen ally with 4 HP.

figures.description: First ancestor of the Dogon who was swallowed and reborn as a serpent, embodying the renewal of the soil.

figures.name: Binu

ability.name: Totemic Bond
ability.description: Choose one animal type; all cards of that type gain +3 to all stats.

figures.description: The totemic ancestor spirits associated with Dogon clans whose shrines receive offerings of millet porridge.

figures.name: Dyongu Serou

ability.name: True Name
ability.description: Name one enemy: reveal all their hidden abilities and reduce their power by 2.

figures.description: The master of speech who taught humans the true names of all things, giving language its power over reality.

figures.name: Sigui Ceremony Spirit

ability.name: Sigui Renewal
ability.description: Once per battle: restore all allies to full HP and reset all debuffs.

figures.description: The spirit of the great Sigui ceremony held every 60 years to renew the cosmic order and honor Lebe.

figures.name: Kanaga Mask

ability.name: World Axis Dance
ability.description: Stabilize the field: no position swaps or repositioning effects can occur for 2 turns.

figures.description: The sacred Kanaga mask dancer who links heaven and earth, bird above and crocodile below.

figures.name: Ginna

ability.name: Elder's House
ability.description: All allies gain +1 defense from family protection for 2 turns.

figures.description: The spirit of the eldest brother's house who guards the patrilineal lineage and ancestral secrets.

figures.name: Wagem

ability.name: Sacred Smith
ability.description: Permanently upgrade one ally's power by +2 through divine smithcraft.

figures.description: The first divine blacksmith who taught the Dogon the secrets of forging and civilization.

figures.name: Dama Ceremony Spirit

ability.name: Dama Passage
ability.description: When any ally falls, that card's stats are distributed as bonuses to remaining allies.

figures.description: The spirit of the Dama funeral ceremony that guides the deceased's nyama life force to its new home.

figures.name: Yasigi

ability.name: Dance of Heaven
ability.description: All allies gain +2 speed; next enemy area-of-effect ability misses all targets.

figures.description: Goddess of dance and masks who oversees all Dogon ceremonial performance and cosmic joy.

figures.name: Pale Fox's Earth

ability.name: Dry Earth
ability.description: Remove all fertility and regeneration effects from the field for 1 turn.

figures.description: The impure earth that Ogo created through his premature and disordered act of creation.

figures.name: Sigi Tolo Star

ability.name: Stellar Secret
ability.description: Grant one ally knowledge of all enemy plans for 1 turn.

figures.description: The spirit of Sirius, the star of the Nommo, whose knowledge the Dogon priests preserved for centuries.

figures.name: Nyama

ability.name: Raw Power
ability.description: Release nyama: deal 4 damage to one enemy but lose 2 HP from the uncontrolled force.

figures.description: The raw spiritual life force present in all living things that becomes dangerous when released at death.

figures.name: Hogon

ability.name: Sacred Authority
ability.description: While this card is in play, enemy disruption and interrupt abilities are suppressed.

figures.description: The Dogon high priest who cannot be touched by anyone but his ritual wife and who guards cosmic order.

figures.name: Tireli Blacksmith

ability.name: Community Craft
ability.description: Upgrade two different allies' lowest stats by +1 each.

figures.description: The sacred blacksmith of Dogon society whose craft clan stands apart and serves the entire community.

figures.name: Granary Spirit

ability.name: Cosmic Granary
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to all allies; their stats cannot be reduced below 3 this turn.

figures.description: The spirit of the Dogon granary whose architecture mirrors the structure of the human body and the cosmos.

figures.name: Crocodile Totem

ability.name: Ancestral Waters
ability.description: All water and river allies gain +2 defense for 1 turn.

figures.description: The crocodile clan ancestor whose spirit dwells in the sacred pool beside the Dogon village.

figures.name: Bayon Mask

ability.name: Hare's Sprint
ability.description: This card acts twice in one turn but takes 1 damage from over-exertion.

figures.description: The hare mask spirit who represents speed and cunning in the Dogon masquerade tradition.
